title.en: National Registry of Diseases (Specified Entity for Acute Myocardial Infarction) Notification 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the National Registry of Diseases (Specified Entity for Acute Myocardial Infarction) Notification 2012 and shall come into operation on 1st September 2012.

heading.en: Specified entity for acute myocardial infarction

text.en: 2. The National Registry of Diseases Office of the Health Promotion Board established under the Health Promotion Board Act (Cap. 122B) is declared to be a specified entity for the collection of information relating to acute myocardial infarction for the purposes of section 24 of the Act.
